question: 25 cm³ of acidified iron(II) solution is titrated with 0.02 mol dm⁻³ potassium dichromate(VI). The mean titre is 20 cm³. What is the concentration of the iron(II) ions? (Cr₂O₇²⁻ + 14H⁺ + 6Fe²⁺ → 2Cr³⁺ + 6Fe³⁺ + 7H₂O)
mark_scheme: A1: 0.096 mol dm⁻³. Accept the value to 2 or 3 significant figures or any more accurate value, equivalent unit prefixes/spellings, and standard form. Wrong unit: no mark. Ignore extra correct working. No mark if the answer is negated, contradicted or two different answers are given.
model_answer: 0.096 mol dm⁻³. n(Cr₂O₇²⁻) = 0.02 × 20/1000; n(Fe²⁺) = 6 × that; c = 0.0960 mol dm⁻³.
common_misconceptions: The ratio of 5 for manganate(VII) has been used.
